criteria.text: Use real session.create + prompt.submit with a fixture registered policy provider and a local deterministic OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Assert received request has the selected model/reasoning and unique frozen instruction marker. Endpoint returns a tool call and final response; the actual Hermes tool loop executes it and transcript contains its result. Assert no OpenCode/API delegation request occurred. Disable/bypass tui_gateway.synthetic_turn.maybe_build_synthetic_agent fixture mode; the native AIAgent must execute.
criteria.reason: Real session.create/prompt.submit, frozen instruction, model name, restricted tools, native read_file result, and final response passed against a local scripted model. Explicit reasoning request bytes, negative OpenCode traffic capture, and an executable gateway child remain unproved.

criteria.text: Create native session with allowed tool names []; capture zero executable tools in provider request. Have endpoint deliberately return a disallowed terminal call anyway; native dispatch returns denial, marker file is absent and no subprocess side effect occurs. A control session with allowlist omitted uses its normal native toolset, proving [] differs from inherit.
criteria.reason: Live [] session offered zero tools and rejected a forged terminal call without a marker side effect; ordinary unbound session offered its native catalog. An omitted allowlist on a bound policy is covered by focused policy tests, not a separate live control.

criteria.text: Permit native terminal and read_file only; configure broad terminal deny plus a later exact safe command allow. The allowed command creates a synthetic marker or returns a nonce; adjacent disallowed command does not. Reverse the rule order and the same command is denied. Include read inside fixture root versus outside/traversal/symlink paths, denied tool omitted from schemas, and direct attempted dispatch denied. All paths use synthetic directories.
criteria.reason: Live ordered read_file allow/deny, symlink escape, and global final deny passed. Focused tests cover terminal scalar matching, literal brackets, slash normalization, ambiguous path rejection, and symlink rule-anchor retarget. Native terminal execution, direct dispatch, and command decomposition remain unproved. Final terminal newline matching is deliberately stricter than Rhythm JS.

criteria.text: With native approval callback denied/unavailable, zero file/process mutation; an explicitly authorized once response executes one operation, then a second distinct call still requires approval. A competing ordinary plugin approve must not bypass policy deny. No call to input() or indefinite wait in headless mode.
criteria.reason: Gateway approval.respond deny and once choices changed real read_file results. A second operation after once, unavailable/headless callback, competing ordinary plugin approval, and bounded timeout remain unproved live.

criteria.text: Inject resolver/evaluator failure, malformed binding and missing policy snapshot. Both real agent executor preflight and direct model_tools dispatch refuse protected operations and produce bounded errors. An ordinary plugin modify cannot turn approved arguments into forbidden ones after evaluation; enforcement sees final effective arguments or rejects post-approval mutation. Assert no side effects.
criteria.reason: Bad resolver selection and injected evaluator failure refused protected reads in the real agent loop. Direct model_tools dispatch and ordinary plugin post-approval mutation remain focused-test only, not live proof.

criteria.text: Launch revision 1, change fixture provider to revision 2, submit again and assert old session still uses v1 prompt and tools; new session uses v2. Resume/restart through native supported session API restores v1 without rereading current mutable policy as authority. Exercise both inline and compute-host construction if enabled. No changes to fixture config.yaml/.env/auth.json/MEMORY.md/USER.md hashes.
criteria.reason: Live provider v1/v2 revision and SessionDB resume kept old instructions frozen; synthetic config/.env/auth/MEMORY/USER hashes held. Separate process restart, compute-host construction, and model reasoning request parity remain unproved.

criteria.text: Run two simultaneous sessions with opposite allowlists; neither inherits the other's tools/rules. Wrong owner/profile/runtime generation or replayed binding fails before a model request. Unknown keys, unsupported version/pattern/critical field fail visibly without dropping fields or reverting to default permissions.
criteria.reason: Cross-session policy replay and oversize instruction were refused before a model request. Concurrent opposite allowlists and live wrong-owner/profile/runtime-generation cases remain unproved.

criteria.text: An ordinary Hermes session with no shared policy retains existing behavior; plugin registration/disposal does not mutate native defaults. Policy limits reject oversize prompt/rule/input before native start. Errors/logs/results expose neither capability material nor credential sentinels.
criteria.reason: Ordinary unbound session retained native tool schemas with provider registered. Lifecycle under process restart and comprehensive error/log/result secret redaction remain unproved.
